tagline: Leading integrated supply chain and logistics platform in China
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of supply chain management and operational efficiency, showing 7% annual growth and reflecting the expansion of product selections and management of major promotional cycles.

kpis.name: Net Inventory
kpis.explanation: Value of inventory in billions of dollars
kpis.description: Net inventory amounted to RMB 95.4 billion ($13.6 billion) as of December 31, 2025, up from RMB 89.3 billion in 2024. The increase reflects the expansion of product offerings and major promotional cycle planning.

kpis.name: Inventory Turnover Days
kpis.explanation: Number of days to renew inventory
kpis.description: Annual inventory turnover days increased from 30.3 days in 2023 to 31.5 days in 2024 and 37.8 days in 2025, indicating slower turnover, linked to product category expansion and inventory strategies for promotional periods.

kpis.name: Accounts Receivable
kpis.explanation: Accounts receivable in billions of dollars
kpis.description: Accounts receivable amounted to RMB 27.3 billion ($3.9 billion) as of December 31, 2025, up from RMB 25.6 billion in 2024, primarily related to amounts due from customers and online payment channels.

kpis.name: Accounts Payable
kpis.explanation: Accounts payable in billions of dollars
kpis.description: Accounts payable amounted to RMB 188.4 billion ($26.9 billion) as of December 31, 2025, slightly down from RMB 192.9 billion in 2024, including accounts payable associated with the retail segment.

kpis.name: Accounts Payable Turnover Days
kpis.explanation: Number of days of supplier payment delay
kpis.description: Annual accounts payable turnover days increased from 53.2 days in 2023 to 58.6 days in 2024 and 60.0 days in 2025, reflecting a gradual extension of payment terms with suppliers.

kpis.name: Net Inventory
kpis.explanation: Value of inventory in billions of dollars
kpis.description: Net inventory amounted to RMB 95.4 billion ($13.6 billion) as of December 31, 2025, up from RMB 89.3 billion in 2024. The increase reflects the expansion of product offerings and major promotional cycle planning.
